usage_instructions: This file contains DEMO DATA only
Used for testing OceanShield AI system functionality
All locations and incidents are synthetic examples
Do not rely on this data for real hazard assessment
Load this data using: python -c "import json; data = json.load(open('data/demo_ocean_incidents.json'))"
To replace with real data: replace the 'demo_incidents' array with actual incident data
